boundaries: No binary, Ghidra project, OpenSpore source, SPORE payload, or historical triage artifact was modified.
No OpenSpore clean-room implementation is treated as original SporeApp.exe behavior.
SDK names establish interface and layout only; contained aliases are not promoted to exact function entries.
No state or transition is inferred solely from vtable adjacency, KG topology, hashes, or a function's region.
The editor-to-gameplay scope is limited to the editor's PlayMode actor/module bridge; no transition into cell gameplay is claimed without a positive editor trace.
The imported PaintSkin, IsPainting, PaletteUI, EditorUI, and several PlayMode addresses are contained or dead aliases; behavior is attributed only to the containing function actually decompiled.

evidence_policy.decompilation: Exact-body decompilation and disassembly are behavior evidence when fields and call order are stable. Decompiler parameter names, enum casts, and inferred locals are not authoritative.
evidence_policy.runtime: No positive original editor, palette, skin, Undo/Redo, or PlayMode trace is present. All workflow transitions are static-only.
evidence_policy.sdk_name_only: SDK names, enums, offsets, and vtable slots establish shape. A named SDK address inside another body is a contained alias and receives the containing entry's mechanics only.
evidence_policy.vtable: Raw cEditor vtable data and the constructor establish the first sixteen IGameMode slots. Additional slots 16-28 are kept opaque.

ownership.fact: Editors::cEditor is the reference-counted editor root and owns/holds the model, histories, worlds, skin, animation world, palettes, UI, and PlayMode support graph; many child controllers retain raw back-pointers.
mStateEditHistory and mEditHistory are separate intrusive vectors but CommitEditHistory appends one record to each and Undo/Redo index them in parallel.
cEditorSkin holds the prepared painter job at +0x5c; preparation replaces and releases the previous job before calling Editors::IBakeManager.
EditorPlayMode holds four IPlayModeModule pointers; input and update fan out to actors/modules through exact vtable slots.

runtime_status.historical_menu_transition: KG probes for HandleMessage, OnMouseDown, and Update missed; this is negative evidence and does not prove the callbacks unreachable

state_variable_invariants: cEditor+0x2b0 mIsActive is zero at construction, zero throughout Initialize, set only near successful OnEnter completion, and cleared at the beginning of OnExit.
cEditor+0x31c mMode is initialized to BuildMode; successful OnEnter requests PaintMode; mode values are restricted to 0, 1, and 2 by the SDK enum.
cEditor+0x148 can hold at most the current opaque manipulator because MouseDown refuses to begin when it is non-null and OnMouseUp/SetEditorModel/mode exit clear it.
cEditor+0x34 stores the mouse button that owns the current manipulator transaction; MouseUp with a different button is rejected.
mEditHistoryIndex is shared by the state and resource vectors; Undo requires it to be greater than 1 and Redo requires it to be less than the resource count.
PaletteUI+0x64 changes only for an in-range category index; the selected category pointer is also used to update page and button state.
